text: Definitions shall record canonical key/kind/type as applicable, export visibility, section/offset/extent/alignment, and global space/mutability/initialization mode. A constant global shall carry its constant tree; a dynamic global shall have null tree and exactly one matching lifecycle node. Named source constants shall not be allocated definitions.
